notes.title: Patch Notes - Update 1.01
notes.notes:
New Features:

 Rewards for defeating bosses: There's now a chance to receive an accessory or a potion as a bonus reward after defeating a boss! 🎉
  Particle effects: Added new particle effects that appear when a boss is defeated.
 New item in the 3rd biome: You can now find a Common Anvil in the third biome to assist you in your journey!

Bug Fixes:

 Multiplayer issues: Fixed an issue where multiplayer wouldn't work on some devices.
 Projectile bug: Resolved a problem where projectiles stopped functioning after death while wearing the Nails item.

Thank you for your support and feedback! 🚀
If you encounter any issues, feel free to report them on the game's forum or via email
